text:
A date literal in a question must stand alone: 2026-09-01-plan.md is a note name, not a day

temporal-query.ts SINGLE_DAY and RANGE use lookarounds so nothing word-like or a hyphen may touch the date; before that, asking about a dated note name filtered that very note out. A further date after a range is refused as ambiguous, never left as a lexical token.

Quoted spans are extracted before the period is recognised; a stopword-only phrase matches adjacently only

pg-w2l/query runs extractPhrases on the whole question and temporalQuery on the rest, so a quoted last week is a phrase someone wrote, not a filter. A phrase with no content words (all stopwords) has nothing to look for in the keyword bag, so it can only match adjacently in a name, title, or heading. Both sides of the adjacency check go through phraseText, the same fold and punctuation strip.
